MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT p
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE
       WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN date_diff('day', STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) / 365.25
       ELSE date_diff('day', STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), STRPTIME(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) / 365.25
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT p,
     STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN STRPTIME('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d') ELSE STRPTIME(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d') END AS ending
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     (DATE_PART('year', ending) - DATE_PART('year', birth) -
      CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', ending) < DATE_PART('month', birth)
             OR (DATE_PART('month', ending) = DATE_PART('month', birth) AND DATE_PART('day', ending) < DATE_PART('day', birth))
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE) AS birth,

WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE_PART('year', ending) - DATE_PART('year', birth) -

                OR (DATE_PART('month', ending) = DATE_PART('month', birth)
